name: Aelnir Photo Kit
seoTitle: Aelnir Photo Kit: compress, resize and convert photos on Android
summary: Compress, resize, convert, crop and turn photos into PDFs, all on your device.
tagline: Compress, resize, convert and crop photos entirely on your phone. No uploads, no backend, nothing to sign up for.

features.title: Every photo job, one app
features.lead: Every tool takes up to 20 photos at once, picked in the app or shared from any other app.

items.title: Compress
items.body: Quality presets, or a target file size. Each photo keeps its format; PNG and HEIC, which a quality setting can't shrink, become JPEG, or WebP when see-through.

items.title: Resize
items.body: Exact size, width only, height only, percentage or longest edge, with aspect-ratio lock and no accidental upscaling.

items.title: Convert
items.body: JPEG, PNG and WebP, lossy or lossless, with a clear choice of background when transparency can't come along.

items.title: Crop and rotate
items.body: Drag to crop, free-form or to common ratios. Rotate in 90° steps and flip either way.

items.title: Make shareable
items.body: One step for sending: resize for chat or email, or fit under 200 KB for upload forms, saved as JPEG with the location removed.

items.title: Image to PDF
items.body: Pick and reorder pages, choose page size, orientation, margins and fit, and build the PDF on your phone.

strip.label: Tools
strip.text: Compress · Resize · Convert · Crop & rotate · Metadata cleaner · Make shareable · Image to PDF · History

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Your photos never leave your phone
note.body: Aelnir Photo Kit is free and supported by ads. Every photo is processed by one engine on your phone. Nothing is uploaded, because there is no server to upload to.

studioProof.hard: One image engine behind every tool, including compression to an exact target file size.
